steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/login as admin/admin; the "Update your password" prompt appeared and I clicked "Skip" to keep the default password. From the dashboards search (ctrl+k) I opened the provisioned "Service Health" dashboard in the "Bench" folder. The dashboard shows three panels, with the following titles exactly as displayed: Request rate | Error count | Latency by endpoint.
